reviews.title: Reliable RAM that just works
reviews.comment:
This RAM is a great option if you are still building on DDR4. It installed easily, was recognized without any issues, and runs well. I like the simple black design because it fits in with pretty much any build without being too flashy.

Performance has been good for gaming and regular everyday use. 16GB is still enough for a lot of setups, and the 3600MHz speed is nice for the price. Corsair has always been dependable for me, and this kit is exactly what I expected: simple, stable, and reliable.
